about_short_description.short_description: Mini Exhibitions create calendar events, send reminder emails, collect team members shipping addresses and ship them goodies.

product.name: Event Hosting
product.description: Mini Exhibitions offers a wide range of events including mixology, cooking, art classes, magic shows, trivia, and unique activities like lockpicking and beekeeping.

product.name: Customized Events
product.description: They provide events tailored for holidays and diversity initiatives, with options for customization based on specific themes.

product.name: Flat Pricing
product.description: Events are offered at a flat rate, regardless of the number of participants, simplifying budget management.

product.name: Administrative Support
product.description: Mini Exhibitions handles administrative tasks such as creating calendar events, sending reminder emails, and coordinating schedules.

product.name: Global Team Coordination
product.description: They accommodate global teams by finding suitable times for events and managing international shipping.

product.name: Slack Channel Integration
product.description: Shared Slack channels are used for communication, running polls, sharing photos, and sending pre-event reminders.
